caseName: McMillan v. Federal National Mortgage Ass'n
caseNameFull: McMillan v. Federal National Mortgage Assn.

opinions.text:
Appeal from App, Dept., Super. Ct. Cal., County of Los Angeles, dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari denied.

Mr. Justice Douglas is of the opinion that probable jurisdiction should be noted.
